# World Health Organization (WHO)
> The United Nations agency working to promote health, keep the world safe and serve the vulnerable.

WHO.int is the primary global hub for WHO guidance, health topics, data, publications, emergencies information, country and regional offices, and technical resources for policymakers, researchers, health workers, journalists, and the public.

## Main WHO Resources
- [Home](https://www.who.int/): WHO global homepage with featured campaigns, news, emergencies, and priority health information.
- [Health Topics](https://www.who.int/health-topics): Directory of diseases, conditions, programmes, and public health subject areas.
- [Newsroom](https://www.who.int/news-room): Central hub for news releases, statements, speeches, and media resources.
- [Data](https://www.who.int/data): WHO data portal for indicators, statistics, and global health monitoring resources.
- [Publications](https://www.who.int/publications): Library of WHO reports, guidelines, manuals, and technical documents.
- [Emergencies](https://www.who.int/emergencies): Information on outbreaks, humanitarian crises, preparedness, and emergency response.
- [Countries](https://www.who.int/countries): Country pages with WHO presence, priorities, and national health information.
- [About WHO](https://www.who.int/about): Organizational overview, leadership, governance, and how WHO works.

## Health Topics
- [Health Topics](https://www.who.int/health-topics): Browse WHO health topics covering diseases, risk factors, and health systems.
- [Coronavirus disease (COVID-19)](https://www.who.int/health-topics/coronavirus): Topic page for COVID-19 guidance, advice, and related resources.
- [Tuberculosis](https://www.who.int/health-topics/tuberculosis): WHO information on TB prevention, diagnosis, treatment, and global burden.
- [Malaria](https://www.who.int/health-topics/malaria): Guidance and facts on malaria prevention, treatment, and elimination efforts.
- [Mental health](https://www.who.int/health-topics/mental-health): Resources on mental health conditions, promotion, and care systems.
- [Air pollution](https://www.who.int/health-topics/air-pollution): Evidence and policy guidance on air quality and health impacts.
- [Diabetes](https://www.who.int/health-topics/diabetes): Information on diabetes prevention, management, and public health response.
- [Immunization](https://www.who.int/health-topics/immunization): Vaccination-related guidance, strategies, and programme information.

## Data, Statistics, and Monitoring
- [Data](https://www.who.int/data): Entry point for WHO data products, collections, and statistical resources.
- [Global Health Observatory](https://www.who.int/data/gho): WHO platform for global health statistics and indicator exploration.
- [Health Inequality Monitor](https://www.who.int/data/inequality-monitor): Data and tools for analysing health inequalities across populations.
- [Mortality Database](https://www.who.int/data/data-collection-tools/who-mortality-database): International mortality and cause-of-death data compiled by WHO.
- [Civil Registration and Vital Statistics](https://www.who.int/data/data-collection-tools/civil-registration-and-vital-statistics-(crvs)): Resources supporting CRVS systems and mortality reporting.
- [Data Collection Tools](https://www.who.int/data/data-collection-tools): WHO tools, standards, and systems for health data collection.
- [Monitoring Health for the SDGs](https://www.who.int/data/gho/data/themes/sustainable-development-goals): SDG-related indicators and global health monitoring resources.

## Publications and Technical Guidance
- [Publications](https://www.who.int/publications): Search and browse WHO books, reports, guidelines, and policy documents.
- [Guidelines](https://www.who.int/publications/guidelines): WHO normative guidance for clinical, public health, and policy decisions.
- [Institutional Repository for Information Sharing](https://iris.who.int/): WHO's digital repository for official publications and archived materials.
- [Bulletin of the World Health Organization](https://www.who.int/publications/journals/bulletin): Peer-reviewed public health journal publishing research and policy analysis.
- [WHO Technical Documents](https://www.who.int/publications/i): Publication series and downloadable technical and policy documents.
- [Classifications](https://www.who.int/standards/classifications): International classifications and coding standards maintained by WHO.

## Standards, Classifications, and Norms
- [Standards and Specifications](https://www.who.int/standards): WHO standards, norms, and technical specifications for health systems and products.
- [Classifications](https://www.who.int/standards/classifications): International health classifications including disease and functioning frameworks.
- [International Classification of Diseases (ICD)](https://www.who.int/standards/classifications/classification-of-diseases): WHO disease classification standards and implementation resources.
- [ICD-11](https://icd.who.int/): Official ICD-11 platform for coding, browsing, and classification resources.
- [International Classification of Functioning, Disability and Health (ICF)](https://www.who.int/standards/classifications/international-classification-of-functioning-disability-and-health): Framework for describing functioning, disability, and health.
- [International Classification of Health Interventions (ICHI)](https://www.who.int/standards/classifications/international-classification-of-health-interventions): Classification system for reporting and analysing health interventions.
- [WHO Model Lists of Essential Medicines](https://www.who.int/groups/expert-committee-on-selection-and-use-of-essential-medicines/essential-medicines-lists): Essential medicines lists and related expert committee resources.

## Emergencies and Outbreaks
- [Emergencies](https://www.who.int/emergencies): WHO emergency preparedness, response, and crisis information portal.
- [Disease Outbreak News](https://www.who.int/emergencies/disease-outbreak-news): Official outbreak updates and risk information from WHO.
- [Health Emergency Dashboard](https://www.who.int/emergencies/situations): Current emergency situations and operational updates.
- [WHO Health Emergencies Programme](https://www.who.int/teams/who-health-emergencies-programme): Programme overview for emergency preparedness, detection, and response.
- [Emergency Appeal](https://www.who.int/emergencies/funding/appeals): Funding appeals supporting WHO emergency operations worldwide.
- [COVID-19 Dashboard](https://data.who.int/dashboards/covid19): WHO dashboard for global COVID-19 cases, deaths, and trends.

## News, Media, and Communications
- [Newsroom](https://www.who.int/news-room): WHO news releases, feature stories, statements, and media materials.
- [News Releases](https://www.who.int/news-room/releases): Official announcements on WHO actions, findings, and initiatives.
- [Statements](https://www.who.int/news-room/statements): Formal WHO statements on health events, policies, and global issues.
- [Commentaries](https://www.who.int/news-room/commentaries): Expert commentary and perspective pieces from WHO.
- [Feature Stories](https://www.who.int/news-room/feature-stories): In-depth stories on health programmes, communities, and impact.
- [Speeches](https://www.who.int/director-general/speeches): Speeches from the WHO Director-General and senior leadership.
- [Events](https://www.who.int/news-room/events): WHO observances, campaigns, and event listings.

## Countries and Regions
- [Countries](https://www.who.int/countries): Country pages with profiles, priorities, and WHO office information.
- [Africa](https://www.afro.who.int/): WHO Regional Office for Africa website and regional health resources.
- [Americas / PAHO](https://www.paho.org/en): Regional site for the Americas with public health guidance and updates.
- [South-East Asia](https://www.who.int/southeastasia): WHO South-East Asia Regional Office information and programmes.
- [Europe](https://www.who.int/europe/): WHO European Region site with regional strategies, data, and news.
- [Eastern Mediterranean](http://www.emro.who.int/index.html): WHO Eastern Mediterranean Regional Office website and resources.
- [Western Pacific](https://www.who.int/westernpacific/): WHO Western Pacific Regional Office programmes, publications, and updates.

## About WHO and Governance
- [About WHO](https://www.who.int/about): Overview of WHO mission, structure, and strategic priorities.
- [Our Work](https://www.who.int/about/what-we-do): Summary of WHO functions, technical work, and support activities.
- [Leadership](https://www.who.int/about/people/leadership): Profiles of WHO leadership and senior management.
- [Director-General](https://www.who.int/director-general): Office, priorities, speeches, and initiatives of the WHO Director-General.
- [Constitution](https://www.who.int/about/accountability/governance/constitution): Foundational constitutional document of the World Health Organization.
- [World Health Assembly](https://www.who.int/about/governance/world-health-assembly): Information on WHO’s decision-making assembly and proceedings.
- [Executive Board](https://www.who.int/about/governance/executive-board): Governance information, membership, and board documentation.
- [Funding](https://www.who.int/about/funding): How WHO is financed and funded across programmes and emergencies.

## Teams, Programmes, and Initiatives
- [Teams](https://www.who.int/teams): Directory of WHO departments, technical teams, and programme areas.
- [WHO Health Emergencies Programme](https://www.who.int/teams/who-health-emergencies-programme): Team page for emergency preparedness and response operations.
- [Science Division](https://www.who.int/teams/science-division): WHO science leadership, evidence functions, and technical support.
- [Universal Health Coverage](https://www.who.int/health-topics/universal-health-coverage): WHO resources on equitable access to quality health services.
- [Antimicrobial Resistance](https://www.who.int/health-topics/antimicrobial-resistance): Guidance and policy resources on antimicrobial resistance.
- [Climate Change and Health](https://www.who.int/health-topics/climate-change): Health impacts of climate change and WHO policy guidance.
- [Immunization Agenda 2030](https://www.who.int/teams/immunization-vaccines-and-biologicals/strategies/ia2030): Strategy resources for global immunization goals through 2030.

## Careers, Procurement, and Contact
- [Careers](https://www.who.int/careers): Employment opportunities, recruitment information, and working at WHO.
- [Procurement](https://www.who.int/about/accountability/procurement): Procurement policies, notices, and supplier information.
- [Internships](https://www.who.int/careers/internship-programme): Information about WHO internship opportunities and application process.
- [Contact WHO](https://www.who.int/about/contact-us): Contact details for WHO headquarters and general enquiries.
- [Permissions and Licensing](https://www.who.int/about/policies/publishing/copyright): Copyright, reuse, and licensing information for WHO content.
- [Donations](https://www.who.int/about/funding/contribute): Ways to contribute financial support to WHO’s work.
